title: If the Villainess and Villain Met and Fell in Love
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Brigitte Meidell, from a prestigious noble family, contracts with a nameless and seemingly weakest spirit and on the same day has her engagement publicly broken off by the third prince, Joseph. Mocked at the Otoleanna Academy of Magic, she clashes with Yuri Aurealis, a gifted but arrogant duke's son whom others fear, and their rivalry slowly turns into love.
life_message: People dismissed as failures or villains can prove their worth and find love through honest rivalry.
